ASSUMPTIONS, NOT OBSERVED SAVINGS

If this repeated every month

Capacity value estimates the value of usable staff time. It is not demonstrated cash savings, revenue, or a guarantee. Observed differences do not establish causation.

The observation ledger

Use the same task scope, unit count, and quality checklist for both runs.

Working time and rework are entered separately and added together. Pass rates use only included rows with both quality checks completed. A quality check applies to the entire matched run.
